label: TCL Google Smart TV (UHD class)

discovered.smoke_cast: 2026-07-30 local mp4 via catt Default Media Receiver OK
discovered.note: Exact retail SKU not in Cast eureka_info — confirm Settings → System → About → Model on the panel

panel.resolution_note: Most modern TCL Google TVs are UHD; confirm inch/series on About screen
panel.viewing_angle_note: VA: marketed ~178° but contrast/color wash off-axis — center seating for dual/mosaic walls. IPS lines hold color better off-axis. Cast cannot change panel physics; use high-contrast large tiles.
panel.color_gamut: model-dependent; cast path forces Rec.709 SDR
panel.lut_path: apply 3D LUT at encode (ffmpeg lut3d / LIVE_DEMUX_CAST_LUT), not TV picture menu

cast_encode.h264_level_note: Default Media Receiver: 1080p30 High@L4.1 is universal; Google TV Cast often accepts 4K H.264 but v1 stays 1080p for reliability

error_handling.offline: retry /cast list; same Wi-Fi (no guest AP isolation); ping 192.168.0.5
error_handling.codec: re-encode H.264+AAC progressive MP4 or short HLS; avoid AV1/HEVC for Default Media Receiver
error_handling.localhost: never cast 127.0.0.1/localhost — serve 0.0.0.0 and use LAN IP
error_handling.black_screen: codec mismatch or URL unreachable from TV; open http://LAN:8791/… from phone on same Wi-Fi
error_handling.discovery_empty: catt scan / dns-sd _googlecast._tcp; wake TV; disable VPN hiding mDNS
error_handling.exclusive_cam: release TTY cam / other ffplay before desk encode
error_handling.wrong_device: two TVs on LAN (TCL Smart TV + Hisense GoogleTV3065) — set LIVE_DEMUX_CAST_DEVICE='Smart TV'
error_handling.hdcp_app_path: rare on Default Media Receiver — stick to local HTTP media

layouts.mosaic: 2x2 xstack: you, phone, stream still, lens still (or placeholders)
layouts.xr_source: phone Continuity + VR browser later feed same encode wall → one Cast session to TCL

wall_content.mosaics: ffmpeg xstack / hstack from still-pipe + desk dual
wall_content.optimized: Rec.709 SDR, high-contrast tiles, avoid 1px chrome (viewing angle)

notes: LAN discovery 2026-07-30: catt → Smart TV = TCL Smart TV @ 192.168.0.5
Do not confuse with Hisense GoogleTV3065 @ 192.168.0.61
Game Mode 120Hz is HDMI path, not Chromecast encode path
Exact retail model: TV Settings → System → About → Model → LIVE_DEMUX_CAST_TV_SKU
